accepted: Android Open Source Project camera HAL documentation
OPPO / OnePlus official product and imaging publications
official OTA/ROM artifacts materialized by the device owner
excluded_from_official_claims: reverse-engineered feature keys without matching official artifact evidence

facts: up to 10-bit color depth photo and video capture

stages.conclusion: The SoC does not impose an 8-bit-only ceiling for still capture.

stages.layer: OPlus system image / build feature layer
stages.conclusion: OPlus historically treated 10-bit HEIF as part of a wider system imaging/HEIF feature stack, not only a Camera UI toggle.

evidence.source: Android Open Source Project: 10-bit camera output
required_signals: P010 or implementation-defined PRIVATE output stream support
Gralloc 4 static or dynamic HDR metadata

stages.conclusion: A real 10-bit public camera path requires HAL metadata and a 10-bit stream path; a feature-menu toggle alone is insufficient.
The public kernel does not expose a OnePlus-13-specific 10-bit HEIF switch. Initial implementation work belongs above camera.ko; kernel work is conditional on an isolated stream/resource failure.

official_artifact_targets: Camera provider/HAL metadata and vendor-tag declarations
media codec and HEIF/HEIC encoder declarations
color-space / HDR / ICC / CICP metadata configuration
Gallery/Photos HEIF and HDR decode/edit capability
required_evidence_before_implementation_: identify the OnePlus 13 official user-space gate or configuration owner
identify the selected HEIF/HEIC encoder path
identify output color primaries/transfer/matrix metadata path
stages.conclusion: This is the principal unresolved official-source layer.

implementation_order: ingest official OnePlus 13 OTA/userspace text/config artifacts
resolve 10-bit HAL dynamic-range and P010/PRIVATE exposure
resolve HEIF/HEIC encoder path and bit-depth control
resolve color primaries/transfer/matrix and HDR metadata path
enter camera.ko/CPAS/ICC/MMRM only after a lower-layer resource failure is proven
non_equivalences: 10-bit HEIF is not the same thing as RAW10/RAW12
10-bit HEIF is not the same thing as JPEG_R / Ultra HDR
ProXDR display metadata is not proof that the stored HEIF samples are 10-bit
P010 stream support is strong HAL evidence but does not by itself prove the proprietary HEIF still encoder is configured for 10-bit
